EventFlow x Sanctuary
Retreat operations, customer planning, finance, and readiness in one simulator
Embedded Platform
Why this is here:
EventFlow now powers the business layer behind Sanctuary: booking intake, admin operations, finance, reminders, sandbox banking posture, and readiness checks. The embedded tabs keep the original EventFlow prototypes available without breaking the retreat simulator.
Platform Integration
Retreat experiences on top of EventFlow operations.
Sanctuary remains the luxury cannabis healing retreat simulator. EventFlow is now embedded as the operational platform that can support planning, booking, event administration, finance reporting, sandbox banking posture, reminders, and customer collaboration.
🌐
Customer Planning
Use EventFlow's full customer journey for event/retreat discovery, packages, client portal, approvals, and collaboration.
🛡
Admin Operations
Run events, guests, vendors, RSVPs, waivers, tasks, communications, and operational status from one admin layer.
💰
Finance + Banking
Review finance prototypes, sandbox-only banking posture, payout requests, reconciliation readiness, and reports.
✅
Readiness Checks
Use the operations checklist to verify backend health, sandbox guardrails, reminders, dependencies, and payout status.

Integrated retreat workflow

1. Guest browses Sanctuary retreat destinations.
2. Guest opens EventFlow customer planning for deeper service/package planning.
3. Booking data can flow to the backend booking API.
4. Reminders stay log-only until delivery is enabled.
5. Payout and ACH flows remain sandbox/tracking-only unless explicitly enabled.

Safety posture

Live money movement remains disabled by default.
Plaid/Stripe are sandbox-template driven until real credentials are configured locally.
The admin operations checklist can read live backend health once the backend is running at localhost:3002.
Legacy Sanctuary EventFlow Finance and Client modules remain available.
Embedded EventFlow module
